name: build each higher-degree interpolant from a pair of lower-degree ones
mechanism: start with the sample values as degree-zero interpolants; combine each adjacent pair into the degree-one interpolant at the query point by a position-weighted blend, then pairs of those into degree two, and so on up a triangular tableau to a single value

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Neville's algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Interpolation and extrapolation:

fails_when: one query per tableau; quadratic work
